scope_note: Source implementation and real independent-coordinator/native-store evidence only. No production account password, installed application or deployment is modified. The interaction contract is diagnostic and no raw frame ledger exists yet; default verify must not be reported as accepted until that evidence is produced. Unit/component tests use isolated test-side adapters and cannot replace the declared live integration or native interactive acceptance.

state_matrix.test: renews near expiry once and retains the original account and token
does not renew a session outside the seven-day window or invent a missing session
does not resubmit an unconfirmed reset or report it as a confirmed sign-out
does not replace a newer account projection when its captured revision changes
rejects incomplete, malformed and extra reset fields before dispatching any owner
